'''G-T7''' was a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the [[Galactic War]], it was stationed at the [[Voss Orbital Docking Station]] above [[Voss]].
